experiment: Trip 1b (CRC16 microbenchmark): REJECTED before measuring anything, both runs.
result: Each run printed 'bench.cfg line 1: expected key=value', 'Bench refused: bench.cfg rejected' and fell back to defaults. Nothing was measured.
reading: The parser skips blank lines and lines whose first character is '#'; anything else needs '='. The shipped t1b-crc16.cfg is plain ASCII, LF, and its line 1 is a '#' comment (the same parser accepts it in the host tests), so line 1 of the file on the card began with something else, most likely an invisible byte-order mark added by an editor. Unconfirmed: the bytes were not seen.
next: The loader will skip a UTF-8 byte-order mark and name what it found on a bad line (bytes shown in hex, UTF-16 called out).
